name: reference_1p4um_bsi_split_pd_design_space
description: Lumerical-style design-object and parameter registry for the open-source image-sensor pixel studio. This records which parameters are wired to the current solvers and which ones are still metadata or candidate-only.

source_basis.reflected_goal: Tabbed tool areas, object tree, result view, viewport, resources, sources, monitors, mesh, materials, and sweeps.
Initial simulation, angle sweep, microlens-shift sweep, electrical weighting function, and G*W-style QE/crosstalk integration.
CRA/MRA, wavelength/angle/pixel-type EQE, weighting function reuse, and camera-system export orientation.
Explicit parameter/result tables and repeatable sweep tasks rather than ad hoc script edits.
Completed objects should expose their available result datasets and allow users to inspect generated monitors, tables, and reports from the project shell.
Result datasets need first-class 1D, 2D image/slice, and 3D/vector viewer affordances with exportable figures.
Monitor data should be treated as structured datasets with parameters and attributes rather than loose image files.
Wavelength-scale pixel optics should be handled as wave optics, with FDTD generation maps rather than ray-only attribution.
Pinned photodiode, transfer gate, floating diffusion, implants, and transport calibration must be represented as solver equations or clearly marked proxy-only.
A fast coarse setup is useful for debugging, but convergence must pass before any result is treated as accuracy evidence.

parameters.label: Pixel pitch
parameters.design_intent: Changes optical periodicity and electrical pixel width; all downstream results become stale.

parameters.label: Microlens height
parameters.design_intent: Primary CRA response and edge roll-off tuning knob.

parameters.label: CFA thickness
parameters.design_intent: Controls color filter absorption and optical phase before silicon.

parameters.label: Passivation thickness
parameters.design_intent: Proxy AR/passivation spacing parameter.

parameters.label: Silicon optical thickness
parameters.design_intent: Changes absorption depth and electrical collection domain.

parameters.label: Split PD gap
parameters.design_intent: Tunes left/right isolation and phase response.

parameters.label: DTI width
parameters.design_intent: Side isolation proxy; wider DTI may reduce crosstalk but can reduce fill factor.

parameters.label: Left BDTI depth
parameters.design_intent: Left backside trench liner proxy depth; measured trench profile is required for accuracy.

parameters.label: Right BDTI depth
parameters.design_intent: Right backside trench liner proxy depth; measured trench profile is required for accuracy.

parameters.label: TG oxide thickness
parameters.design_intent: Currently metadata/proxy only; true gate electrostatics still need DEVSIM equation support.

parameters.label: FD depth max
parameters.design_intent: Current solver keeps FD mostly as proxy doping/metadata.

parameters.label: Pinning acceptor
parameters.design_intent: Front pinning layer proxy; affects surface field and collection in current profile-PPD model.

parameters.label: Storage n-well donor
parameters.design_intent: Primary photodiode storage doping proxy.

parameters.label: Front fixed charge
parameters.design_intent: Sheet-to-volume fixed-charge proxy; does not include occupancy-dependent interface traps.

parameters.label: Left BDTI acceptor
parameters.design_intent: Left BDTI p-liner proxy dose; measured BDTI liner implant is required for accuracy.

parameters.label: Right BDTI acceptor
parameters.design_intent: Right BDTI p-liner proxy dose; measured BDTI liner implant is required for accuracy.

parameters.label: Front interface Dit
parameters.design_intent: Converted into potential-dependent trap charge and SRH sheet recombination proxy in DEVSIM.

parameters.label: Electron mobility max
parameters.design_intent: Upper bound of the doping-dependent electron mobility model wired into DEVSIM edge current.

parameters.label: Electron mobility ref doping
parameters.design_intent: Doping scale for the Caughey-Thomas-style electron mobility roll-off.

parameters.label: SRH lifetime max
parameters.design_intent: Upper bound of the doping-dependent SRH lifetime model wired into DEVSIM generation/recombination.

parameters.label: Electron saturation velocity
parameters.design_intent: Velocity-saturation scale for field-dependent electron edge mobility.

parameters.label: Electron field mobility beta
parameters.design_intent: Canali-style high-field roll-off exponent for electron edge mobility.

parameters.label: Chief ray angle X
parameters.design_intent: Camera-system field response axis; current reference has center and edge20x only.

parameters.label: Meep resolution
parameters.design_intent: Convergence knob; low smoke settings are not accuracy evidence.

variants.label: Baseline reference
variants.goal: Current center/edge20x reference used by the Studio.

variants.label: Lens height +8%
variants.goal: Explore whether a stronger microlens improves edge CRA response.
variants.expected_effect: Could improve edge collection but may worsen center/color balance.

variants.label: Split gap +50%
variants.goal: Increase left/right split isolation for PDAF phase response.
variants.expected_effect: May increase split contrast but reduce total collection.

variants.label: Front fixed-charge stress
variants.goal: Probe sensitivity to front-interface fixed charge before real interface-trap equations exist.
variants.expected_effect: Can reveal sign and magnitude sensitivity of surface electrostatics.
risks: Fixed sheet proxy is not a trap model

workflow_gates.label: Smoke
workflow_gates.pass_condition: Scripts run, terminal balance finite, all referenced output files exist.

workflow_gates.label: Trend exploration
workflow_gates.pass_condition: Convergence report passes and native/W_proxy/W_mesh disagreement is recorded for each field point.

workflow_gates.label: Accuracy LUT
workflow_gates.pass_condition: Measured stack geometry, measured n,k, calibrated transport/collection, true weighting/collection model, and measured target validation pass.
